name: forge
description: A stage-by-stage workflow skill set (fg-*). A development loop that takes one task through a single cycle of ask·plan → execute → retro → cleanup. Consists of fg-ask (inquiry/triage + grill-with-docs-style conversational grilling), fg-execute (backlog selection menu · Run all, Dynamic Workflow execution), fg-learn (retro · doc promotion), and fg-cleanup (tidy-up · seal · re-run guard). Use in contexts like 'start a new task', 'start with forge', 'let's work on this', 'refine the plan'.
